failures.question: I want to analyze how the Signal-to-Noise Quality Indicator (SNQI) varies across different weather conditions. For each weather condition, give weather condition name, the average SNQI, the median SNQI, and count how many analyzable signals there are. Sort the result by average SNQI in descending order.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH signal_weather AS (
  SELECT 
    s.SnrRatio,
    s.NoiseFloorDbm,
    o.WeathProfile,
    (s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm)) AS SNQI
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    WeathProfile,
    SNQI,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY WeathProfile ORDER BY SNQI) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY WeathProfile) AS cnt
  FROM signal_weather
),
medians AS (
  SELECT 
    WeathProfile,
    AVG(SNQI) AS median_SNQI
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn IN ((cnt+1)/2, (cnt+2)/2)
  GROUP BY WeathProfile
),
aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    WeathProfile,
    AVG(SNQI) AS avg_SNQI,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN SNQI > 0 THEN 1 END) AS analyzable_count
  FROM signal_weather
  GROUP BY WeathProfile
)
SELECT 
  a.WeathProfile AS weather_condition,
  a.avg_SNQI AS average_SNQI,
  m.median_SNQI AS median_SNQI,
  a.analyzable_count AS analyzable_signals_count
FROM aggregates a
JOIN medians m ON a.WeathProfile = m.WeathProfile
ORDER BY a.avg_SNQI DESC;
failures.sol_sql: WITH signal_quality AS ( SELECT s.SignalRegistry, s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm) AS SNQI, o.WeathProfile FROM Signals s JOIN Telescopes t ON s.TelescRef = t.TelescRegistry JOIN Observatories o ON t.ObservStation = o.ObservStation ), ranked_quality AS ( SELECT WeathProfile, SNQI, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY WeathProfile ORDER BY SNQI) as row_num, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY WeathProfile) as total_count FROM signal_quality ) SELECT WeathProfile, AVG(SNQI) AS avg_snqi, (SELECT SNQI FROM ranked_quality WHERE WeathProfile = rq.WeathProfile AND row_num = (total_count + 1) / 2) AS median_snqi, SUM(CASE WHEN SNQI > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS analyzable_signals FROM ranked_quality rq GROUP BY WeathProfile ORDER BY avg_snqi DESC;

failures.question: I want to find signals that might contain structured information by analyzing their stability patterns. For each candidate, show the signal ID, signal type, Signal Stability Metric, one field that contains a combined stability textual report formatted exactly as: "Frequency: <frequency stability>, Phase: <phase stability>, Integrity: <signal integrity>" and the CIP Classification Label.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT
    s.SignalRegistry,
    s.SignalClass,
    (1 - ABS(s.FreqDriftHzs) / NULLIF(s.FreqMhz * 1000.0, 0)) * (s.SigDurSec / (1 + s.DoppShiftHz / 1000.0)) AS SSM,
    sd.FreqStab,
    sd.PhaseStab,
    sd.SigIntegrity,
    sc.EntropyVal,
    s.ModIndex,
    CASE
      WHEN (1 - ABS(s.FreqDriftHzs) / NULLIF(s.FreqMhz * 1000.0, 0)) * (s.SigDurSec / (1 + s.DoppShiftHz / 1000.0)) > 0.8
           AND sc.EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.4 AND 0.8
           AND s.ModIndex > 0.5
        THEN 'Coherent Information Pattern Detected'
      WHEN (1 - ABS(s.FreqDriftHzs) / NULLIF(s.FreqMhz * 1000.0, 0)) * (s.SigDurSec / (1 + s.DoppShiftHz / 1000.0)) > 0.6
           AND sc.EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.9
        THEN 'Potential Information Pattern'
      ELSE 'No Clear Pattern'
    END AS CIP_Label
  FROM signals s
  LEFT JOIN signaldynamics sd ON s.SignalRegistry = sd.SignalRef
  LEFT JOIN signalclassification sc ON s.SignalRegistry = sc.SignalRef
)
SELECT
  SignalRegistry AS signal_id,
  SignalClass AS signal_type,
  SSM AS signal_stability_metric,
  'Frequency: ' || COALESCE(FreqStab, 'N/A') || ', Phase: ' || COALESCE(PhaseStab, 'N/A') || ', Integrity: ' || COALESCE(SigIntegrity, 'N/A') AS combined_stability_report,
  CIP_Label AS cip_classification_label
FROM candidate
WHERE CIP_Label != 'No Clear Pattern'
ORDER BY CIP_Label DESC, SSM DESC;
failures.sol_sql: WITH stability_analysis AS ( SELECT s.SignalRegistry, s.SignalClass, s.FreqDriftHzs, s.FreqMhz, s.SigDurSec, s.DoppShiftHz, s.ModType, s.ModIndex, sd.SigIntegrity, sd.FreqStab, sd.PhaseStab, sc.EntropyVal, ((1 - ABS(s.FreqDriftHzs)/(s.FreqMhz * 1000)) * (s.SigDurSec/(1 + s.DoppShiftHz/1000))) AS SSM FROM Signals s INNER JOIN SignalDynamics sd ON s.SignalRegistry = sd.SignalRef INNER JOIN SignalClassification sc ON s.SignalRegistry = sc.SignalRef ), stability_attrs AS ( SELECT SignalRegistry, 'FreqStab' AS attribute, FreqStab AS value FROM stability_analysis UNION ALL SELECT SignalRegistry, 'PhaseStab' AS attribute, PhaseStab AS value FROM stability_analysis UNION ALL SELECT SignalRegistry, 'SigIntegrity' AS attribute, SigIntegrity AS value FROM stability_analysis ) SELECT sa.SignalRegistry, sa.SignalClass, ROUND(sa.SSM, 3) AS SSM, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN sa.attribute = 'FreqStab' THEN 'Frequency: ' || sa.value WHEN sa.attribute = 'PhaseStab' THEN 'Phase: ' || sa.value WHEN sa.attribute = 'SigIntegrity' THEN 'Integrity: ' || sa.value END, ', ') AS stability_factors, CASE WHEN sa.SSM > 0.8 AND sa.EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.4 AND 0.8 AND sa.ModIndex > 0.5 THEN 'Coherent Information Pattern Detected' WHEN sa.SSM > 0.6 AND sa.EntropyVal BETWEEN 0.3 AND 0.9 THEN 'Potential Information Pattern' ELSE 'No Clear Pattern' END AS pattern_assessment FROM ( SELECT sa.SignalRegistry, sa.SignalClass, sa.SSM, sa.EntropyVal, sa.ModType, sa.ModIndex, stability_attrs.attribute, stability_attrs.value FROM stability_analysis sa JOIN stability_attrs ON sa.SignalRegistry = stability_attrs.SignalRegistry ) AS sa GROUP BY sa.SignalRegistry, sa.SignalClass, sa.SSM, sa.EntropyVal, sa.ModType, sa.ModIndex;

failures.question: Classify signals by TOLS Category, and for each group, show the category name, signal count, average Bandwidth-to-Frequency Ratio, and the standard deviation of the anomaly score.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        s.signalregistry,
        s.bwhz,
        s.centerfreqmhz,
        sp.techsigprob,
        sp.natsrcprob,
        sp.sigunique,
        sp.anomscore
    FROM signals s
    INNER JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
    WHERE sp.techsigprob IS NOT NULL
      AND sp.natsrcprob IS NOT NULL
      AND sp.sigunique IS NOT NULL
      AND sp.anomscore IS NOT NULL
      AND s.bwhz IS NOT NULL
      AND s.centerfreqmhz IS NOT NULL
),
tols_data AS (
    SELECT
        signalregistry,
        CAST(bwhz AS REAL) / (centerfreqmhz * 1000000.0) AS bfr,
        techsigprob * (1 - natsrcprob) * sigunique * (0.5 + CAST(anomscore AS REAL) / 10.0) AS tols,
        CAST(anomscore AS REAL) AS anom_score
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN tols < 0.25 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN tols < 0.75 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'High'
    END AS Category,
    COUNT(*) AS signal_count,
    AVG(bfr) AS avg_bfr,
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN NULL
        ELSE SQRT(
            (SUM(anom_score * anom_score) - SUM(anom_score) * SUM(anom_score) / COUNT(*))
            / (COUNT(*) - 1)
        )
    END AS anom_stddev
FROM tols_data
GROUP BY Category
ORDER BY
    CASE Category
        WHEN 'Low' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2
        WHEN 'High' THEN 3
    END;
failures.sol_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.TechSigProb * (1 - p.NatSrcProb) * p.SigUnique * (0.5 + p.AnomScore/10) < 0.25 THEN 'Low' WHEN p.TechSigProb * (1 - p.NatSrcProb) * p.SigUnique * (0.5 + p.AnomScore/10) < 0.75 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'High' END AS tol_category, COUNT(*) AS signal_count, AVG(s.BwHz/(s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000)) AS avg_bfr, AVG(p.AnomScore*p.AnomScore) - AVG(p.AnomScore)*AVG(p.AnomScore) AS anomaly_stddev FROM Signals s JOIN SignalProbabilities p ON s.SignalRegistry = p.SignalRef GROUP BY tol_category

failures.question: Which observatory stations are discovering the most potential technosignatures? For each station, display the observatory name, how many signals meet our technosignature criteria, their average TOLS score, average BFR values, and what percentage of all detected technosignatures they've found. I need this ranked by the stations with the most discoveries first.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH tech_signals AS (
    SELECT
        s.signalregistry,
        t.observstation AS station,
        sp.techsigprob,
        sp.natsrcprob,
        sp.sigunique,
        sp.anomscore,
        s.bwhz,
        s.centerfreqmhz,
        sc.infodense
    FROM signals s
    JOIN signalprobabilities sp ON s.signalregistry = sp.signalref
    JOIN signalclassification sc ON s.signalregistry = sc.signalref
    JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    WHERE sp.techsigprob > 0.7
      AND sp.natsrcprob < 0.3
      AND sp.artsrcprob < 50
      AND (s.bwhz / (s.centerfreqmhz * 1000000.0)) < 0.001
      AND sc.infodense > 0.8
),
computed AS (
    SELECT
        station,
        signalregistry,
        (techsigprob * (1 - natsrcprob) * sigunique * (0.5 + anomscore / 10.0)) AS TOLS,
        (bwhz / (centerfreqmhz * 1000000.0)) AS BFR
    FROM tech_signals
),
total AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_tech FROM computed
)
SELECT
    o.observstation AS observatory_name,
    COUNT(c.signalregistry) AS technosignature_count,
    AVG(c.TOLS) AS avg_tols,
    AVG(c.BFR) AS avg_bfr,
    (COUNT(c.signalregistry) * 100.0 / total.total_tech) AS percentage_of_total
FROM computed c
JOIN observatories o ON c.station = o.observstation
CROSS JOIN total
GROUP BY o.observstation
ORDER BY technosignature_count DESC
failures.sol_sql: WITH tech_signals AS ( SELECT s.SignalRegistry, s.TelescRef, p.TechSigProb * ( 1 - p.NatSrcProb ) * p.SigUnique * ( 0.5 + p.AnomScore / 10 ) AS TOLS, s.BwHz / ( s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000 ) AS BFR FROM Signals AS s JOIN SignalProbabilities AS p ON s.SignalRegistry = p.SignalRef WHERE p.TechSigProb > 0.7 AND p.NatSrcProb < 0.3 AND p.ArtSrcProb < 50 AND s.BwHz / ( s.CenterFreqMhz * 1000000 ) < 0.001 ) SELECT t.ObservStation, COUNT(*) AS potential_tech_signals, AVG(ts.TOLS) AS avg_tols, AVG(ts.BFR) AS avg_bfr, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tech_signals ) AS percentage_of_total FROM tech_signals AS ts JOIN Telescopes AS t ON ts.TelescRef = t.TelescRegistry GROUP BY t.ObservStation ORDER BY potential_tech_signals DESC NULLS FIRST

For each modulation type, display the modulation type, the number of signals, the average Modulation Complexity Score (MCS), and average signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Also include a detailed JSON with each signal's MCS and SNR values. Keys are the signal record IDs, and values are inner objects containing two fields: `mcs` – the signal’s MCS value, and `snr` – the SNR value.

WITH signal_mcs AS (
    SELECT
        s.SignalRegistry,
        s.ModType,
        s.ModIndex,
        s.SnrRatio,
        (1 - ABS(s.FreqDriftHzs) / NULLIF(s.FreqMhz * 1000.0, 0)) * (s.SigDurSec / NULLIF(1.0 + s.DoppShiftHz / 1000.0, 0)) AS SSM,
        CASE s.ModType
            WHEN 'AM' THEN 2

            ELSE 1

    FROM signals s
    WHERE s.ModType IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT

    COUNT(*) AS signal_count,

    json_group_object(
        SignalRegistry,
        json_object('mcs', ModIndex * (1 + SSM) * M_factor, 'snr', SnrRatio)
    ) AS details
FROM signal_mcs
GROUP BY ModType
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY ModType;

I need a summary by observatory showing the observatory name, their total signal count, average Research Priority Index (RPI) and approximate Confirmation Confidence Score (CCS) values, number of high-priority (RPI > 3) signals, number of high-confidence signals, and especially the number of signals that meet both criteria. SELECT

    COUNT(s.signalregistry) AS total_signal_count,
    AVG((sp.TechSigProb * 4 + sp.BioSigProb / 100 + sp.SigUnique * 2 + sp.AnomScore / 2) * (1 - sp.FalsePosProb)) AS avg_RPI,
    AVG((1 - sp.FalsePosProb) * sd.DecodeConf * sc.ClassConf *
        (CASE WHEN (s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm)) > 0
              THEN (s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm)) / 10 + 0.5
              ELSE 0.1 END)) AS avg_CCS,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ((sp.TechSigProb * 4 + sp.BioSigProb / 100 + sp.SigUnique * 2 + sp.AnomScore / 2) * (1 - sp.FalsePosProb)) > 3
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_priority_count,

                   (CASE WHEN (s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm)) > 0
                         THEN (s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm)) / 10 + 0.5
                         ELSE 0.1 END)) > 0.8
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_confidence_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ((sp.TechSigProb * 4 + sp.BioSigProb / 100 + sp.SigUnique * 2 + sp.AnomScore / 2) * (1 - sp.FalsePosProb)) > 3
               AND ((1 - sp.FalsePosProb) * sd.DecodeConf * sc.ClassConf *
                    (CASE WHEN (s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm)) > 0
                          THEN (s.SnrRatio - 0.1 * ABS(s.NoiseFloorDbm)) / 10 + 0.5
                          ELSE 0.1 END)) > 0.8

The output should group stations by whether meets OOW (bool:True or False). For each group, you should provide its boolean value of OOW, the count of stations, average AOI (rounded to 3 decimal places) and a JSON array whose elements each include  `station` (observatory name), `aoi` (AOI value), `lunar_factors` object with `stage` (lunar stage) and `distance` (lunar distance), and `solar_status` (solar status).

        observstation,
        atmostransparency * (1.0 - humidityrate / 100.0) * (1.0 - 0.02 * windspeedms) AS AOI,

            'lunar_factors', json_object('stage', lunarstage, 'distance', lunardistdeg),

    AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity,
    AVG(illumelux) AS avg_illumination,
    AVG(esi) AS avg_esi
  FROM env_esi
  GROUP BY zoneref
),
with_quartile AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref, avg_temp, avg_humidity, avg_illumination, avg_esi,
    NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_esi) AS quartile
  FROM avg_env
)
SELECT 
  s.zoneregistry AS "Site Code",
  s.zonelabel AS "Site Name",
  wq.avg_temp AS "Average Temperature",
  wq.avg_humidity AS "Average Humidity",
  wq.avg_illumination AS "Average Illumination",
  wq.avg_esi AS "Average ESI",
  wq.quartile AS "ESI Quartile",
  CASE 
    WHEN wq.avg_esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
    WHEN wq.avg_esi >= 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
    WHEN wq.avg_esi >= 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
    ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions'
  END AS "ECCS Classification"
FROM with_quartile wq
JOIN sites s ON wq.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
ORDER BY s.zoneregistry;

failures.question: I want to evaluate each scan processing workflow's Processing Efficiency Ratio and identify whether it qualifies as a Processing Bottleneck. For each combination of processing software and stage, please include the software, stage, average processing hours, average CPU and GPU usage percentages, average data size in GB, the average PER value, and the the efficiency status ('Bottleneck Detected' if it is qualified as processing bottleneck, 'Efficient' if it is not). Additionally, provide the total count of workflows for each combination. Sort the results by bottleneck status first, followed by the PER value in ascending order.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH workflow_per AS (
    SELECT
        sp.FlowRegistry,
        sp.FlowSoft,
        sp.FlowStage,
        sp.FlowHrs,
        sp.ProcCPU,
        sp.ProcGPU,
        COALESCE(SUM(sc.GBSize), 0) AS total_gb,
        COALESCE(SUM(pc.TotalPts), 0) AS total_pts,
        CASE 
            WHEN (sp.FlowHrs * (sp.ProcCPU + sp.ProcGPU) / 200.0) > 0 
                AND SUM(sc.GBSize) > 0 
                AND SUM(pc.TotalPts) > 0 
            THEN 
                (SUM(sc.GBSize) * LOG(10, SUM(pc.TotalPts))) / (sp.FlowHrs * (sp.ProcCPU + sp.ProcGPU) / 200.0)
            ELSE 0
        END AS per
    FROM ScanProcessing sp
    LEFT JOIN Scans sc ON sp.ZoneRef = sc.ZoneRef
    LEFT JOIN ScanPointCloud pc ON sc.ArcRef = pc.ArcRef AND sc.CrewRef = pc.CrewRef
    GROUP BY sp.FlowRegistry, sp.FlowSoft, sp.FlowStage, sp.FlowHrs, sp.ProcCPU, sp.ProcGPU
)
SELECT
    FlowSoft,
    FlowStage,
    AVG(FlowHrs) AS avg_flow_hrs,
    AVG(ProcCPU) AS avg_cpu,
    AVG(ProcGPU) AS avg_gpu,
    AVG(total_gb) AS avg_data_size_gb,
    AVG(per) AS avg_per,
    CASE WHEN AVG(per) < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status,
    COUNT(*) AS workflow_count
FROM workflow_per
GROUP BY FlowSoft, FlowStage
ORDER BY efficiency_status ASC, avg_per ASC;
failures.sol_sql: SELECT sp.flowsoft AS processing_software, sp.flowstage AS processing_stage, ROUND(CAST(AVG(sp.flowhrs) AS REAL), 1) AS avg_processing_hours, ROUND(CAST(AVG(sp.proccpu) AS REAL), 0) AS avg_cpu_usage_pct, ROUND(CAST(AVG(sp.procgpu) AS REAL), 0) AS avg_gpu_usage_pct, ROUND(CAST(AVG(s.gbsize) AS REAL), 1) AS avg_data_size_gb, ROUND( CAST(AVG( s.gbsize * LOG(10, COALESCE(spc.totalpts, 1000000)) / ( sp.flowhrs * ( sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu ) / 200 ) ) AS REAL), 1 ) AS avg_per, CASE WHEN AVG( s.gbsize * LOG(10, COALESCE(spc.totalpts, 1000000)) / ( sp.flowhrs * ( sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu ) / 200 ) ) < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status, COUNT(*) AS workflow_count FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN scans AS s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneref LEFT JOIN scanpointcloud AS spc ON s.arcref = spc.arcref WHERE sp.flowhrs > 0 AND ( sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu ) > 0 GROUP BY sp.flowsoft, sp.flowstage ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG( s.gbsize * LOG(10, COALESCE(spc.totalpts, 1000000)) / ( sp.flowhrs * ( sp.proccpu + sp.procgpu ) / 200 ) ) < 0.5 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END NULLS LAST, avg_per NULLS LAST

failures.question: For each archaeological site, I need its Point Cloud Density Ratio and Feature Extraction Efficiency to identify sites with high potential for feature extraction. Please include the site code, average PCDR value, and average FEE value. Ensure that all sites are included, even if some data might be missing. Sort the results by average FEE in descending order.
failures.pred_sql:
WITH pcdr_base AS (
    SELECT 
        scans.ZoneRef,
        spc.TotalPts,
        spc.CloudDense,
        sp.AreaM2
    FROM scans
    JOIN scanpointcloud spc ON scans.ArcRef = spc.ArcRef AND scans.CrewRef = spc.CrewRef
    JOIN scanspatial sp ON spc.ArcRef = sp.ArcRef AND spc.CrewRef = sp.CrewRef
),
site_pcdr AS (
    SELECT 
        ZoneRef,
        AVG(1.0 * TotalPts / NULLIF(CloudDense * AreaM2, 0)) AS avg_pcdr,
        AVG(CloudDense * 1.0) AS avg_cloud_dense
    FROM pcdr_base
    GROUP BY ZoneRef
),
site_fee AS (
    SELECT 
        sf.ZoneRef,
        (AVG(sf.TraitCount) + AVG(sf.ArtiCount)) * 1000.0 / 
            (NULLIF(sp.avg_pcdr, 0) * SQRT(NULLIF(sp.avg_cloud_dense, 0))) AS avg_fee
    FROM scanfeatures sf
    JOIN site_pcdr sp ON sf.ZoneRef = sp.ZoneRef
    GROUP BY sf.ZoneRef, sp.avg_pcdr, sp.avg_cloud_dense
)
SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry AS site_code,
    sp.avg_pcdr,
    sf.avg_fee
FROM sites s
LEFT JOIN site_pcdr sp ON s.zoneregistry = sp.ZoneRef
LEFT JOIN site_fee sf ON s.zoneregistry = sf.ZoneRef
ORDER BY sf.avg_fee DESC;
failures.sol_sql: WITH feature_potential AS ( SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, spc.totalpts, spc.clouddense, ss.aream2, CASE WHEN spc.clouddense > 0 AND ss.aream2 > 0 THEN spc.totalpts / ( spc.clouddense * ss.aream2 ) ELSE 0 END AS pcdr FROM sites AS si LEFT JOIN scans AS s ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref LEFT JOIN scanpointcloud AS spc ON s.arcref = spc.arcref LEFT JOIN scanspatial AS ss ON s.arcref = ss.arcref ), extraction_metrics AS ( SELECT fp.site_code, fp.pcdr, sf.traitcount, sf.articount, CASE WHEN fp.pcdr > 0 THEN ( sf.traitcount + sf.articount ) / ( fp.pcdr * SQRT(fp.clouddense) ) * 1000 ELSE 0 END AS fee FROM feature_potential AS fp JOIN scanfeatures AS sf ON fp.site_code = sf.zoneref ) SELECT site_code, ROUND(CAST(AVG(pcdr) AS REAL), 2) AS avg_pcdr, ROUND(CAST(AVG(fee) AS REAL), 2) AS avg_fee FROM extraction_metrics GROUP BY site_code ORDER BY avg_fee DESC NULLS FIRST
